item.title: I am not dissatisfied with development in Ocala. I’d actually like more in Marion Oaks.
item.description: "There are many that are dissatisfied with all the new development. But I am not. I have been living in Marion Oaks for 2.5 years and have to spend a lot of time grocery shopping on State Road 200, 20-25 minutes one way. Marion Oaks has many many new homes and lots of new families. Plenty of land for development. I believe more stores should be built inside Marion Oaks.
